tutorials.title: Economy-wide impact assessment
tutorials.summary: Change Italy’s electricity supply, calculate the effects on value added, imports and GHG emissions, and export the model to CVXLab.

tutorials.title: Disaggregate MRIOs
tutorials.summary: Split a sector in a two-region toy MRIO using MARIO, an Excel inventory and CVXLab.
tutorials.intro: Split cement from a broader sector in a two-region toy MRIO, using an Excel inventory and CVXLab to reconcile the expanded table. The supplied teaching workbook is derived from GTAP 12; the full database is not required.

tutorials.title: Use BONSAI and calculate GHG footprints
tutorials.summary: Calculate hybrid input-output GHG footprints with MARIO and compare them with BONSAI's exported GWP100 results.

tutorials.title: Import and inspect BONSAI
tutorials.summary: Read BONSAI HSUT and HIOT models, inspect regional classifications and units, and review import diagnostics.

tutorials.title: Compare GHG footprints across databases
tutorials.summary: Characterize EXIOBASE, Eora26 and ADB emissions, align regions and units, and compare production and consumption footprints.

tutorials.title: Trace a nickel supply chain
tutorials.summary: Compare nickel trade across EXIOBASE years, attribute embodied impacts and examine concentration and exposure.

tutorials.title: Trace motor-vehicle supply chains
tutorials.summary: Trace CO2 paths serving German motor-vehicle demand, then assess the coverage of the retained paths.

collections.title: Use BONSAI and calculate GHG footprints
collections.summary: Import BONSAI, inspect its regional classifications and units, then calculate and compare GHG footprint multipliers.
collections.intro: The footprint notebook runs independently. Use the first part to inspect both HSUT and HIOT models; the footprint calculation needs the HIOT files only.

collections.title: Trace supply chains
collections.summary: Study nickel trade and regional exposure, then trace the upstream CO₂ paths serving German motor-vehicle demand.
collections.intro: The two cases use different methods: trade-content attribution for nickel and structural path analysis for motor vehicles. Each has its own notebook and source years.

parts.title: Nickel: trade, embodied impacts and exposure
